template.name: GeyserMC & Floodgate
template.description: Allow Minecraft Bedrock Edition players to join your Paper/Spigot Java server. Installs the latest GeyserMC and optionally Floodgate so Bedrock players can join without a Java account.

variables.label: Bedrock Port
variables.description: The UDP port Bedrock players connect on (usually 19132). Add a matching allocation in the Network tab.

variables.label: Install Floodgate
variables.description: Allow Bedrock players to join without owning Minecraft Java Edition.

variables.label: Authentication Mode
variables.description: How Geyser authenticates Bedrock clients against the Java server. Use floodgate when Floodgate is installed.

variables.label: Bedrock MOTD (Line 1)
variables.description: First line displayed in the Bedrock server list.

variables.label: Bedrock MOTD (Line 2)
variables.description: Second line displayed in the Bedrock server list.

steps.name: Write GeyserMC configuration
steps.content:
# GeyserMC configuration
bedrock:
  address: 0.0.0.0
  port: {{ bedrock_port }}
  clone-remote-port: false
  motd1: {{ motd_line1 | tojson }}
  motd2: {{ motd_line2 | tojson }}
  server-name: {{ server.name | tojson }}
  compression-level: 6
  enable-proxy-protocol: false

remote:
  address: auto
  port: {{ server.port | default(25565, true) }}
  auth-type: {{ auth_type }}
  allow-password-authentication: true
  use-proxy-protocol: false
  forward-hostname: false

floodgate-key-file: key.pem
allow-third-party-capes: true
allow-third-party-ears: false
show-cooldown: title
show-coordinates: true
disable-bedrock-scaffolding: false
